class.name: SteamStatsSubmission
class.brief_description: The per-edit outcome of a stats draft submitted to the local Steam cache.

method.name: get_applied
method.description: Returns how many edits Steam accepted into its local cache.

method.name: get_failed_at
method.description: Returns the zero-based index of the rejected edit or -1 when there is no individual failure.

members.member: Number of edits Steam accepted into the local cache. This can be positive on failure if a later edit or persistence request was rejected.
Zero-based index of the first edit that failed preflight or was rejected by a Steam setter. Use -1 as the sentinel for an outcome without an individual failed edit.
